# Real-footage results (generated by scripts/real_report.py)

Source: USGS gauge cameras + USGS gauge height (public domain); see data/usgs/README.md.

## Locked test blocks (final gate, second and last run; see note)

Coverage after sharpness gate: 82.3%

| scope | method | n | MAE cm | 95% CI (block bootstrap) | RMSE cm | bias cm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all_frames | learned | 283 | 3.11 | 1.81-4.01 | 8.93 | -2.09 |
| all_frames | threshold_baseline | 283 | 11.67 | 6.47-15.29 | 14.81 | -8.13 |
| all_frames | always_no_flood | 283 | 19.77 | 18.98-20.32 | 22.45 | -19.77 |
| gated | learned | 233 | 0.79 | 0.77-0.82 | 1.20 | +0.02 |
| gated | threshold_baseline | 233 | 11.52 | 6.49-15.04 | 14.62 | -8.73 |
| gated | always_no_flood | 233 | 18.90 | 18.39-19.26 | 21.12 | -18.90 |

MAE by depth bin (gated, learned):

| bin cm | n | MAE cm |
|---|---|---|
| 0-0.5 | 6 | 0.00 |
| 0.5-10 | 39 | 1.63 |
| 10-25 | 122 | 0.76 |
| >=25 | 66 | 0.43 |

Per-block MAE (gated): median 0.79, IQR 0.78-0.81, worst 0.82 cm.


Note: the locked blocks were evaluated first with a one-sided sharpness gate (results/real/final_v1_gate_one_sided_metrics.json). The two-sided gate was then chosen from DEV-block error only and the locked run repeated with --force; both runs are in results/real/final_test_log.jsonl.
